#OTD in 1992 at the Barcelona Olympic Games, Jackie Joyner-Kersee won the gold medal in the heptathlon, becoming the first person in history to win back-to-back Olympic titles in the multi-event sport.

She is widely considered one of the greatest female athletes of all time. #WomenInSport #champion

item.description:
Billy, the music loving dog is taken to the music hall filled with musicians practicing and listens for the sound that pleases him the most.

It’s the cello. 🎻

He lays down basking in the waves of sounds he chose out of all the others.

Music is the universal language.

#DogsofBluesky #MusicSky

item.title: Three years ago, our reporter received an envelope with no r…
item.author: ProPublica (@propublica.org)
item.description:
Three years ago, our reporter received an envelope with no return address.

Inside was a flash drive containing tens of thousands of files: years of secretly recorded conversations, private militia chat logs and videos sent by a man named John Williams.

(Published Jan. 2025)
